description: Defines classes and templates for handling text streams with different terminators, including null, carriage return, and line feed terminators. Implements mechanisms for sending and receiving text data with termination detection and handling within the Thunder::Core namespace.

classes.name: TerminatorCarriageReturnLineFeed
classes.description: Handles combined '\n\r' termination detection with internal state tracking.

classes.name: StreamTextType
classes.description: Template class for managing text streams with customizable terminators, including sending, receiving, and handling text data.

methods.name: IsTerminated
methods.description: Detects if a character signifies termination based on the terminator type.

methods.name: SizeOf
methods.description: Returns the size of the terminator in characters.

methods.name: Marker
methods.description: Returns the string marker representing the terminator.

methods.name: SendData
methods.description: Sends data from the internal queue, appending terminator markers as needed.

methods.name: ReceiveData
methods.description: Processes incoming data, detects termination sequences, and triggers callbacks.
